description: The bar chart illustrates the Shapley values for different linguistic layers (L4+, L3, L2, L1, T, R1, R2, R3, R4+) of three multilingual BERT models: mBERT, XLM-R, and chLSTM. The vertical axis represents the Shapley value, which is a measure of the contribution of each layer to the model's performance, with a scale ranging from 0 to 80. The horizontal axis lists the linguistic layers, which are ordered from L4+ to R4+. The bars are color-coded, with mBERT in light blue, XLM-R in dark blue, and chLSTM in green. The T layer has the highest Shapley value for all models, with mBERT reaching approximately 80, XLM-R around 60, and chLSTM close to 40. The other layers have significantly lower Shapley values, with mBERT, XLM-R, and chLSTM showing similar patterns across the layers. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
